description_zh: 创建资源目录云账号类型的成员
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager create-cloud-account --display-name admin-0000 --parent-folder-id fd-bVaRIG0000 --email someone@example.com --payer-account-id 123233440000 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudAccount

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the member account.

The name must be 2 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

The name must be unique in the current resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
成员名称。

长度为2~50个字符或汉字，可包含汉字、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、英文句点（.）和短划线（-）。

成员名称在资源目录内必须唯一
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder
parameters.name: parent_folder_id

parameters.help_en: The email address used to log on to the cloud account
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: The ID of the settlement account. If you do not specify this parameter, the current account is used for settlement
parameters.help_zh: 结算账号ID。取值为空表示采用当前账号结算
parameters.name: payer_account_id
